C-PRINT-LIFECYCLE-TESTS.Name: Print/export lifecycle test coverage: the docx export branch proves its write and both failure legs at component level, and the C-61-delivered e2e print-export net gains its companion zero-write assertions while V-M-052's dangling webkit selector is re-aimed
C-PRINT-LIFECYCLE-TESTS.Summary: This is a pure test-coverage change — no production file is touched. (1) The docx branch of editor.vue's handleExport (src/renderer/src/components/editorWithTabs/editor.vue:2589-2639) has no component-level lifecycle pin anywhere: nothing proves that a successful docx export ends in the store write dispatch carrying the embedded HTML while never engaging the print container (the branch's documented «No settings dialog, no print container» contract, editor.vue:2592-2594, is asserted only at the e2e layer in export-office.spec.ts:47); the failure surface splits into two legs with different observables — the render-stage leg (a failure inside exportStyledHTML/embedLocalImages before the dispatch) is caught by editor.vue's own catch (log + localized editor.export.failed «Word» notice, editor.vue:2630-2637) and is unpinned anywhere, while the conversion leg can never be silent (the store's own catch notifies the same key, store/editor.js:2316-2323, and is pinned in store isolation, export-docx-dispatch.test.js:123-129) — what is missing there is only the component-level proof that the dispatched handoff still reaches that catch. The nearest component pins stop short (editor-export-images.test.js:622-643 ends at the embed pass :642). (2) The e2e half of this change is annotation-plus-companion, not creation: tests/e2e/print-export.spec.ts exists — it is C-61's own delivered artifact (.grace/changes/archive/C-61/spec.xml:33 lists it «(new)»; plan.xml:138-144 plans the three invoke-order cases and records the exact V-M-052 command at :141) — and its three pins already deliver V-M-052 scenario-2's recorded e2e trace: print = mt_print_webview only, no dialog, platform-conditioned container check (:30-72); pdf = plugin:dialog|save then mt_export_pdf, zero mt_print_webview (:74-115); pdf save-cancel corner-2 (:117-146). What is actually missing: (a) the paired START_BLOCK_PRINT_EXPORT_LIFECYCLE/END_BLOCK_PRINT_EXPORT_LIFECYCLE markup the e2e convention requires (export-document-pin.spec.ts:30 precedent) — the file carries only a prose header today; (b) the print pin's companion zero-disk-write half — its filtered invoke trace covers only mt_print_webview/mt_export_pdf/plugin:dialog|save and never asserts the absence of mt_fs_write/mt_fs_write_binary, so «print never writes a file» is unpinned at the e2e layer; and (c) the live defect in .grace/verification/runtime.xml V-M-052's Commands entry (:13064-13067) is the «--project=webkit» selector: the file path resolves against the existing file, but the selector names no project in playwright.config.ts (:38-126 — every webkit project is a scoped webkit-* name), so the command fails on the unknown project — dangling since C-61, whose own plan recorded the same selector. This change adds two failing-first docx pins plus one meaningful-proof handoff pin to editor-print-clearup.test.js, extends the C-61-delivered print-export.spec.ts with the paired block and the zero-write assertions (the three delivered pins keep their assertions; pdf control and corner-2 stay byte-identical), and re-aims the V-M-052 selector. The wave-5 audit's proposed «print: on Windows the container is kept» pin is recorded as an audit drift: it already exists (editor-coverage.test.js:2295-2312, isOsx:false harness) and is not duplicated.

Problem.Description: Verified against the current tree (worktree green-w5c, branch spec/print-lifecycle-tests, base 09226066) on 2026-11-25, rev-2 after provenance correction. (1) The docx export branch has no component-level lifecycle evidence (wave-5 audit F-001 remainder). editor.vue's handleExport routes four types; the print and pdf branches are well pinned — editor-print-clearup.test.js (4 pins, :271-399, file-level isOsx: true at :161-167) proves the macOS print clear-after-panel-close, the pdf captured-options capture, the pdf save-cancel corner (nothing written, no notice, container cleared) and the pdf success (mt_export_pdf + clearup), and the Windows/error legs live in editor-coverage.test.js's isOsx:false harness (:245): the print branch keeps the container on Windows (:2295-2312, «expect(mockPrinter.clearup).not.toHaveBeenCalled()» at :2312) and clears it on a failed print (:2315-2328). The docx branch (editor.vue:2589-2639) has nothing of this shape. Its documented contract — «No settings dialog, no print container (both pinned in export-office.spec.ts)» (:2592-2594) — is asserted only at the e2e layer (export-office.spec.ts:47 «never a settings dialog, never the print surface»); at the component level the nearest pins stop earlier: editor-export-images.test.js:622-643 proves the docx PlantUML consent decision reaches exportStyledHTML and that the embed pass runs (embedMock called once, :642) but never asserts the docx flow's completion — no EXPORT dispatch, no print-surface-absence assertion; and tests/renderer/store/export-docx-dispatch.test.js pins the store's EXPORT('docx') write in store isolation (PURPOSE :4; conversion-failure notice :123-129), not the editor.vue branch that feeds it. The failure surface is two legs, not one: a render-stage failure (exportStyledHTML or embedLocalImages rejects before the dispatch at editor.vue:2629) lands in editor.vue's own catch (log + one localized editor.export.failed «Word» notice, editor.vue:2630-2637) — that catch is unpinned anywhere; a conversion failure (exportToDocx rejects after the dispatch) is caught and always notified by the store's own catch (store/editor.js:2316-2323 — a conversion failure is never silent) and is already pinned in store isolation (:123-129). A regression that, say, rendered a print container on the docx path, dispatched the write twice, or broke the editor.vue render-stage catch would pass every existing suite. (2) The verification layer's e2e promise is delivered but under-asserted and its command is broken one way, not two. tests/e2e/print-export.spec.ts exists — provenance: it is C-61's own delivered artifact (archive spec.xml:33 «tests/e2e/print-export.spec.ts (new)»; plan.xml:138-144 «E2E print-export.spec.ts (invoke-order traces) + shim mocks»; the file's own header, :1-17, says «C-61 (split Print and Export to PDF)») — and its three pins already make V-M-052 scenario-2's e2e sentence (:13092-13095) true: print = mt_print_webview only, no dialog, with the container asserted per build host (:30-72); pdf = plugin:dialog|save then mt_export_pdf and zero mt_print_webview (:74-115); pdf save-cancel writes nothing and clears the container (:117-146). The residual gaps are: the file carries no GRACE semantic block (prose header only, no paired START_BLOCK_/END_BLOCK_, unlike export-document-pin.spec.ts:30); the print pin's invoke trace is filtered to mt_print_webview/mt_export_pdf/plugin:dialog|save (:66-71) and therefore never asserts that print writes no file (no mt_fs_write/mt_fs_write_binary absence check); and V-M-052's Commands entry (:13064-13067) runs «npx playwright test tests/e2e/print-export.spec.ts --project=chromium --project=webkit» where the file resolves but the «--project=webkit» selector names no project in playwright.config.ts (:38-126 — every webkit entry is a scoped webkit-* name: webkit-footnotes, webkit-tables, …), so the recorded command fails today on the unknown project — a defect inherited verbatim from C-61's own plan (:141). The shim's reserved seam (tauri-shim.ts:142-148, mt_print_webview/mt_export_pdf null defaults at :147-148) is correctly named and in active use by the delivered file — not a dangling reservation. Net effect: the docx branch's observable end-to-end behavior is unprotected at the component level, and the e2e net runs without its companion zero-write assertion and without the markup the repo's governance requires of new semantic blocks.

Goals.R-1: DOCX-LIFECYCLE-PINS (two failing-first, one meaningful-proof): editor-print-clearup.test.js gains three pins proving the docx branch's observable end-to-end behavior at the component level, on the existing harness (mocked Muya/Printer/Tauri surfaces, real store via setupTestPinia, file-level isOsx: true unchanged). Pin one — «docx: a successful export writes the rendered document through the store and never engages the print container» (failing-first): drive the bus 'export' handler with type 'docx' using the suite's fence-free markdown — the gate declines silently with no card (count 0; this suite has no consent-card machinery and none is added; precedent editor-export-images.test.js:610-619) — let the real M-065 embed pass no-op over the image-free HTML (this suite has no embed double; the pass consumes no fs surface here), resolve the save dialog to a .docx path and stub the lazy '@/util/exportDocx' conversion double; the test observes exactly one store EXPORT dispatch carrying the embedded html content beside pageOptions and the additive exportPin (objectContaining style), exactly one save dialog with the Word filter, exactly one conversion consumed with the post-embed HTML followed by one binary write, and — the lifecycle half — mockPrinter.renderMarkdown and mockPrinter.clearup both never called: the docx flow never creates a print container, so there is nothing to clear. Red-first: no assertion of this shape exists at component level (the docx branch appears in no component suite outside the consent-gate wiring pin and the e2e layer). Pin two — «docx: a render-stage failure surfaces the Word-branch failure notice and dispatches nothing» (failing-first): reject the render double (mockEditorInstance.exportStyledHTML rejects before any dispatch) and observe exactly one localized editor.export.failed error notice (the key exists today, en.json:83) raised by editor.vue's own catch (editor.vue:2630-2637), zero store EXPORT dispatches, no save dialog, no conversion, zero print-container activity. Red-first: the editor.vue docx catch is unpinned anywhere. Pin three — «docx: a conversion failure reaches the store's catch through exactly one dispatch» (meaningful-proof, recorded honestly): resolve the save dialog to a .docx path, reject the '@/util/exportDocx' conversion double, and observe exactly one store EXPORT dispatch (the handoff), exactly one editor.export.failed «Word» notice raised by the store's catch (store/editor.js:2316-2323 — the notice export-docx-dispatch.test.js:123-129 already owns in store isolation; this pin proves the component→store handoff still reaches it), no editor.vue-level duplicate notice, zero binary writes, zero print-container activity. Not a defect detector — the store leg is pinned in isolation and always notifies; the red-first artifact is the absent component-level handoff assertion, recorded as such. All three pins assert observable behavior — dispatches, dialog payloads, write counts, container counters, notice titles/severity — never implementation internals.
Goals.R-2: PRINT-EXPORT-E2E COMPANION (annotation plus zero-write assertions, honest about what C-61 already delivered): tests/e2e/print-export.spec.ts is extended in place on its existing harness (installTauriShim + bootEditor + openFileTab, __mockInvoke per-test overrides, __invokeLog traces) — it is not created; the file is C-61's delivered artifact (archive spec.xml:33, plan.xml:138-144). The additions: (i) one named paired START_BLOCK_PRINT_EXPORT_LIFECYCLE/END_BLOCK_PRINT_EXPORT_LIFECYCLE block wrapping the existing describe, per the markup rules (export-document-pin.spec.ts:30 precedent); (ii) the print pin's companion zero-disk-write half: the pin's filtered invoke trace gains mt_fs_write/mt_fs_write_binary and asserts their absence — «print never writes a file» becomes asserted at the e2e layer (today the filter, :66-71, covers only mt_print_webview/mt_export_pdf/plugin:dialog|save); the delivered assertions (exactly one mt_print_webview, no export-settings dialog, platform-conditioned container check) stay as shipped. The pdf control pin («the pdf invoke-order trace is save then mt_export_pdf, zero mt_print_webview», :74-115) and the pdf corner-2 pin (:117-146) stay byte-identical — they already deliver V-M-052 scenario-2's pdf half and the cancel corner; nothing is re-asserted or duplicated. Recorded honestly: nothing in R-2 is red-first defect coverage — the behavior shipped in C-61 and the file exists; the deliverables are the governance markup, the companion zero-write assertion, and the fact that the recorded verification sentence becomes fully executable once R-3 fixes the selector.
Goals.R-3: GOVERNANCE (implementation bundle, same-bundle rule): .grace/verification/runtime.xml's V-M-052 Commands entry (:13064-13067) is re-aimed — the file path already resolves against the delivered file; only the «--project=webkit» selector is broken, and the fix is either dropping that selector or adding a scoped webkit-print-export project entry to playwright.config.ts in the same bundle (the unscoped name matches no project, config :38-126); the V-M-052 scenario text and the M-011 graph summary delta (.grace/graph/runtime.xml) name the three docx pins and the e2e additions; editor-print-clearup.test.js gets its VERSION bump and a START_CHANGE_SUMMARY entry. The plan records, as a lane-wide follow-up outside this change, that V-M-057's chrome-native-theme command carries the identical dangling «--project=webkit» selector (runtime.xml :13169) — the pattern predates this change and is fixed in its own lane, not here. No production source file, no locale file (both notice keys exist: en.json:69 editor.print.failed, en.json:83 editor.export.failed) and no backend file is touched by this change.
